target.statement: CF-GAN achieves 24.13 FID on edges2shoes with 4.77 GFLOPs and 2.56 MB model size

compute.basis: Paper reports 8 GPU hours for the full coarse-to-fine search on edges2shoes; no code released, so the entire supernet training, three-stage search, and fine-tuning pipeline must be reimplemented from scratch, which is infeasible on a CPU-only laptop within a few hours.

blockers: Full NAS pipeline (supernet pretraining + path/operator/channel search + fine-tuning) must be reimplemented from scratch
Requires GPU training (8 GPU hours reported)
FID evaluation requires a pretrained Inception network
title: Coarse-to-Fine Searching for Efficient Generative Adversarial Networks
